Container.Name: steamos-headless
Container.Overview: SteamOS (built from Valve's package repos) running Steam Big Picture headless, streamed to Moonlight with Sunshine. One image for AMD and NVIDIA; the GPU is detected at start. Install the NVIDIA Driver plugin first on NVIDIA systems.

Config.Name: Steam home
Config.Description: Steam client, login, settings and Sunshine pairings (and games, unless Games library is set). Use a pool/cache path, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Games library (optional)
Config.Description: Optional game library on the array/HDD. It's added to Steam automatically (Settings > Storage). Leave empty to keep games in Steam home.

Config.Name: NVIDIA driver cache
Config.Description: Cached NVIDIA userspace driver (unused on AMD).

Config.Name: Input devices
Config.Description: Needed for Moonlight controllers, keyboard and mouse.

Config.Name: udev database
Config.Description: Lets the container see Sunshine's virtual input devices.

Config.Name: GPU vendor
Config.Description: auto detects the GPU. Only set this on hosts with both AMD and NVIDIA GPUs.

Config.Name: GPU (optional)
Config.Description: On hosts with several GPUs, use only this one: PCI address from the 'GPUs found' table at the top of the container log, e.g. 0000:c1:00.0. Empty = pick automatically. Lets two containers each own one GPU.

Config.Name: SSH public key (optional)
Config.Description: Allows SSH into the container as deck on port 2222 with this key (no passwords). For debugging; leave empty to keep SSH off.

Config.Name: Sunshine password
Config.Description: Web UI login password. Leave empty to create the account in the web UI.

Config.Name: Start resolution
Config.Description: Resolution at the very first start. Each Moonlight client switches to its own, and later starts use the last client's.

Config.Name: Start refresh rate
Config.Description: Refresh rate at the very first start; later starts use the last client's.

Config.Name: Add-ons (optional)
Config.Description: Steam Deck add-ons to install, comma-separated: decky, emudeck, retrodeck, heroic, lutris, bottles, protonup, protontricks, geforcenow, xcloud, firefox, chrome, discord, flatseal. Empty installs nothing. Details: https://github.com/dlommm/steamos-headless/blob/main/docs/add-ons.md

Config.Name: Extra Flatpak apps (optional)
Config.Description: Other Flathub apps to install, by app ID, comma-separated, e.g. com.spotify.Client,tv.kodi.Kodi

Config.Name: Decky plugins (optional)
Config.Description: Plugins from Decky's store, by name, comma-separated, e.g. CSS Loader,SteamGridDB,ProtonDB Badges. Installs Decky too.

Config.Name: Add to Steam (optional)
Config.Description: Which installed apps to add to Steam as non-Steam games for Gaming Mode. Empty = the game launchers (heroic, lutris, retrodeck, geforcenow, xcloud); none = nothing; or names/app IDs, e.g. default,discord
